hypothesis: A supervised policy trained to pursue reachable safe bombing tiles can improve eliminations in empty-board endgames, while a hard context gate preserves the confirmed fallback whenever crates, visible coins, bombs, or explosions remain.
changed_factor: Candidates add one 74-input, 32-hidden-unit pursuit classifier at confidence 0.70 or 0.85. It may override the frozen DQN only in hazard-free states with opponents but no crates or visible coins; the broad persistent loop guard remains active afterward.
controls: Same frozen DQN checkpoint, features, Q-values, broad loop guard, action mask, opponents, scenarios, slots, and paired evaluation seeds. The classifier cannot change checkpoint weights and solo coin/crate behavior is outside its activation set.

collection.layouts: Open hunting layouts only; distances cycle through 2, 3, 5, and 7. Baseline rollouts supply states; labels use only public-state shortest paths to verified safe attack tiles.

selection: Reject training unless a fixed confidence threshold passes grouped teacher-agreement gates. Among fresh-pilot-eligible thresholds, select the largest paired kill gain, then score gain, then the higher threshold. Confirm once on fresh worlds; never promote automatically.

pc.note: Cumulative issue #225 debit through the resource-stopped V12 attempt; the shared 40 CPU-hour cap is not reset.

authorization.record: 2026-09-21: primary goal is killing without losing reduced looping or learned abilities; autonomous training and selection decisions authorized through final submission preparation.
authorization.scope: Teacher-state collection, supervised pursuit training, paired evaluation, confirmation, watcher recovery, evidence export, and packaging only after every registered gate passes.
